# Public types in shipped client packages that no spec covers a single line of.
#
# Seeded 2026-08-19 from a real coverage run, not from a name grep. Entries may only be REMOVED:
# a new public type with no coverage fails the build. Removing one means a spec now exercises it.
#
# The entry that matters is AppendedEventWithResultShouldExtensions - 36 lines of assertion helper
# shipped for consumers to call, with nothing verifying any of it. Most of the rest are exception
# types whose only uncovered lines are a constructor, which is why this is a baseline to work down
# rather than a bug list to fix at once.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   python3 .github/scripts/assert-public-api-coverage-ratchet.py --report
# and the surface list it is filtered against with:
#   python3 .github/scripts/report-public-api-surface.py > .github/public-api-surface.txt
